utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Which book club meeting do you mean, and what details would you like me to check?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I mean the next book club meeting—can you check the time and where it’s being held?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the next book club meeting time and whether it’s at the library, then I’ll confirm for you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what do you need help with for the book club?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—did I miss the book club pick?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries — you didn’t miss it yet. We’re still deciding on the book club pick.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re still narrowing it down, but I’ll fill you in as soon as we pick one.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so Thursday at 7 on Maple Street is still on, right? Just text me when the book title is locked in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, Thursday at 7 on Maple Street is still on, and I’ll text you the book title as soon as we lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Can’t wait — I’m looking forward to hearing what you narrow it down to!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thursday at the cafe works better for me, as long as it’s after school. I’ll check the kids’ schedule and send the updated details along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thursday at the cafe sounds perfect — just send the updated details when you know after-school timing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Where are we meeting this time, and what book are we reading?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re meeting Thursday evening at the cafe, and we’re reading the one about the lighthouse.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Thursday evening at the cafe works for me. Just send the book title when you’ve confirmed it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the Thursday after-school one at the library—I think I’m free, but I may have missed the latest details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh good, you’re probably still in! I’ll text you the time, address, and book pick right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — I probably missed a bit, so text me the time and book pick when you can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re meeting Thursday at 7, same place as usual. I’ll bring the notes and we can go over the chapters one by one.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, that works for me. I’ll read the chapters before Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect—then we’ll be right on schedule Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’m still waiting on the scoop myself—if they’ve narrowed it down, I bet it’s between a cozy mystery and something dramatic.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds about right — just let me know the title and time once it’s settled, so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear the title and time. I’m betting it’ll be a lively one.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what’s the book club reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m not sure yet, but I’ll check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks—just let me know when you find out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll text you the book club title and details as soon as I have them, and Thursday at 7 still sounds great.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Mara — I appreciate it. I’ll wait for the title and details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: You’re welcome — I’ll send the title and details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—just text me the book club title when you have it, and I’ll keep Thursday at 7 open.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — I’ll pass it along as soon as Rosa sends the title. Thursday at 7 sounds great.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks — I’ll keep Thursday at 7 open and can grab snacks when I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — the book club is now Thursday at the cafe, not Tuesday at the library. I’ll make sure everyone on the block has the updated details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll pass the update along and keep an eye out for any last-minute notes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate that. If anything changes, I’ll send out another update right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll keep it after school and make sure everyone has the Thursday cafe details. Thanks for helping get the group updated.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — that works great for me too. I’ll let the other parents know it’s Thursday after school at the cafe.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful — I’ll confirm Thursday after school at the cafe with the whole group. Thanks, Faye; that should make it easy for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh right—what mystery novel did you pick, and when are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m still waiting on the title too—once I get it, I’ll text you. Next Thursday at 7 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, next Thursday at 7 works for me too—just text me the title when you get it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks—what book did the club pick?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I forgot the title again. Were we talking about the next meeting or the book we picked?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I meant the book we picked, if you remember it. I’m mostly just trying to catch up on the club this week.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a spare folding chair and a couple pitchers if the book club could use them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s really kind of you, Gus — thank you. I’m mostly listening this week, but I’d love to hear what book the club picked.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I haven’t heard the pick yet, but I can ask around and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: The library still works for me, but could we lock down the time and book title soon?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re still on for Thursday at 7 at the library, and I’ll check the book title so we can have it settled soon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, 7 at the library works for me. Just send the book title when you’ve got it so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I haven’t heard the pick yet—what are we reading?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still waiting on the book title, but we’re meeting at the library after school on Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—I’ll wait for the title and plan on Thursday at the library after school.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — that’d be great. I’ll watch for the details and pass along anything I hear too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Nell — I’ll send the book choice and time as soon as I hear it. If you catch any rumors before then, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s moved to Thursday at the cafe now, not Tuesday at the library. I’ll check the supplies and bring the snack list too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it—Thursday at the cafe works for me. Let me know if you want me to pick up anything while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira — could you grab some napkins and a pack of cups? I’ll handle the rest of the snacks and bring the list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time works for you, and should we meet at the library on Oak Street?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: The library on Oak Street works for me, and I’m free after 6. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How about 7 PM at the library on Oak Street?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll send you the latest book club details and make sure you’re in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — I’ll check the Thursday evening meeting time and whether it’s at the library, then confirm for you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Hana — thanks for checking. I’ll keep an eye out for the book title and location so I can pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—book club, right? I might’ve missed the update, so can you send me the time and place?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t got the exact time and place yet, but I heard they’re deciding the next read tonight. I’ll poke around and let you know as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Tess — I probably missed the update, so just let me know once you hear the time, place, and next book.
